sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 229 x 259 x 484 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

UPJunior user manual, specifications page (a manualsdir copy) read 2026-11-12: "Female XLR input with male XLR loop output", differential electronically balanced; one 8 in LF cone driver and one 2 in compression driver on an 80 x 50 degree horn. The next page of the same manual (read through a search summary) lists the AC connector as "a PowerCon with looping output": the colour (blue, the 20 A input type) is not stated, so the plan row carries assumedConnectors power-in. The size 484 H x 229 W x 259 D comes from the plan (manual and PSSL page); the PSSL page and Meyer's own datasheet could not be read today (HTTP 429, 404). The page gives no plan taper and no handles: a plain rounded box, radius 6 mm is our estimate. The `power` switch is the simulator power control, not a documented switch. Positions are guesses.
